chapter: War years, Goodman and Woody Herman
title: The Commodore band on the road; Mildred ill
summary: The band opened the Meadowbrook, played college dates and worked nightly; Mildred, unwell, was told to take it easy, and the partnership dissolved.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
